binary_indicator_scoring: Each confirmed, source-cited indicator=1 point, maximum5. Unknown/contradictory/unverified=0; false=0. Unweighted evidence-missing state retained. No renormalization of weights. Score is not probability or strategy quality.

cost_scoring.missing_book_or_fee: 0 entire cost criterion; no optimistic price or subjective missing fill
cost_scoring.primary_scenario: base API taker entry+taker exit; no discounts; equal BTC/ETH and five USD sizes
cost_scoring.total_cost_bps: 2*taker_fee_bps + median snapshot BUY impact + median snapshot SELL impact, equal size/symbol mean; funding excluded and separately assessed; bid/ask crossing included in impact from mid

safety: trade permission separated from withdraw OR explicit equivalent scoped agent signing
IP allowlist OR explicitly documented scoped-wallet security
jurisdiction/account applicability documented; not a user-account eligibility claim

access: public metadata succeeds from research environment
public book succeeds BOTH symbols at two captures
cost_realism: two snapshots and all five USD sizes both sides covered
history: exact BTC/ETH perpetual native M15 documented
two-year old M15 sentinel or official archive actually retrieved for BOTH symbols
missing-bar semantics documented, no synthetic interpolation
metadata: current exact BTC/ETH price-filter identity verified
historical instrument snapshots/epochs recoverable with actual evidence
prospective causal capture possible without backdating

hard_execution_gates: base API fee knowable with official current evidence
no withdraw permission needed where key model; equivalent scoped wallet evaluated explicitly
hard_research_gates: current defensible tick filters BOTH symbols
two-year old native M15 public sentinel or official archive verified BOTH symbols
causally known prospective metadata capture possible
at least one approved environment public access success; severe current geo-block remains penalty
historical_tick_warning: Research venue selection is not historical executable epoch/backtest readiness; unknown tick intervals stay unknown

liquidity_scoring.metric: equal BTC/ETH, five sizes and both sides mean of median mid-referenced impacts; at least2 snapshots each symbol; every size fully fillable

missing_data_rule: Unknown indicator=0, missing fee/book criterion=0; missing hard prerequisite excludes role regardless of score. No redistributed weights or invented values. Ties lexicographic venue slug; report tie, not superiority.

sensitivity.promotions: excluded in primary and sensitivity; report no change
sensitivity.redistribution: other execution weights multiplied proportionally to keep total100; no criterion retuning
sensitivity.snapshot: remove each one in turn; if fewer than2 remain, liquidity/cost become0, no favorable replacement
sensitivity.unknown_depth: hard depth prerequisite remainsfalse when unverified; sensitivity additionally zeroes history score of documentary-only evidence

snapshot_sampling: two separated bounded public books per symbol where possible, using all retained valid captures; median plus worst; not future execution guarantee
